## 🎯 Objective
Implement robust driver management system with WebDriverManager integration, multi-browser support, and abstract base test class for better test framework architecture.

## 📋 Tasks
- [ ] Integrate WebDriverManager (bonigarcia) for automatic driver management
- [ ] Create `DriverManager.java` for thread-safe driver management
- [ ] Implement `DriverFactory.java` with multi-browser support (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- [ ] Create abstract `BaseTest.java` class for common test setup/teardown
- [ ] Update `TextBoxTest.java` to extend BaseTest
- [ ] Enhance `Configuration.java` with additional driver configuration options
- [ ] Test multi-browser compatibility and headless modes
- [ ] Verify thread safety for parallel test execution

## 🔧 Technical Details

### Driver Factory Architecture
```java
DriverFactory
├── createChromeDriver()
├── createFirefoxDriver()
├── createEdgeDriver()
└── createSafariDriver()
```
## Base Test Class Features

- Common setup/teardown methods
- Driver initialization and cleanup
- Wait strategy management
- Common utility methods for all tests

---

## WebDriverManager Benefits

- Automatic driver downloading and setup
- Version management for browser drivers
- Cross-platform compatibility
- Simplified driver maintenance

---

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

- WebDriverManager successfully manages browser drivers automatically
- Multi-browser support working (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- Headless mode configurable for all browsers
- Thread-safe driver management implemented
- BaseTest class provides common functionality to all tests
- Existing tests continue to work with new architecture
- CI/CD pipeline remains stable

- Requires Exception Handling framework (`v0.4.0`): #23
- Requires Log4j2 integration (`v0.3.0`): #18
- Compatible with existing configuration system

## 📝 Notes
